name: Keel Payroll
description: Payroll agent for a small business. Converts USD₮ to a local stablecoin on Textile FX and pays an allowlisted contractor.

skills.name: Pay contractors in local stablecoins
skills.description: Quote USD₮ into wBRL, wARS, cNGN, IDRX, wMXN, or wCOP on Textile FX and pay an allowlisted address inside a revocable cap.
examples: pay Maria (Brazil) $0.10 for the translation, Juan (Argentina) $0.20 for testing
